theater: 江西饒州鄱陽與豫章郡

battle.name: 操師乞
battle.theater: 江西饒州鄱陽與豫章郡
battle.brief: 大業十二年（616）十二月癸未，饒州鄱陽人操師乞自號元興王，建元始興，攻陷豫章郡城，任林士弘為大將軍；隋將劉子翊討伐，操師乞中箭而歿，林士弘接眾在鄱陽湖斬劉子翊。卡面這件早王朝埃及長矛與本役不同代，但密集長矛守垣的用法，正是這場起義在城牆與水路口的用兵骨架。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 交戰的兩方是隋朝與操師乞、林士弘率領的江南起義軍。隋朝此時已是名存實亡的帝國：大業十二年（616），煬帝楊廣駐在江都，遠在洛陽的尚書省兵部只能靠文書與符印調動軍隊，地方上靠郡丞、縣令與郡兵、縣兵維持秩序。開皇年間的府兵編制到這時已被連年徵發抽空，大業朝的野戰主力其實是募兵與郡兵混編的隊伍，兵籍多不實數。江南的形勢尤其鬆散：郡縣兵久未操演，鄉里之間宗族私兵與部曲各有所恃，郡府對鄉村的控制只剩下文書。操師乞一方則是典型鄉民起事的樣貌——以饒州鄱陽一鄉的農民、逃戶、漁戶與市井散兵為主體，首領自號元興王，置大將軍林士弘，號令一體而裝備自備，沒有朝廷的軍籍與給養。江西一帶同時還有其他割據者：梁帝蕭銳據江漢，張善安起於方與，馮盎世領廣州，丘和守北越，杜伏威、陳稜、張金虎等部眾在江淮活動。大業六年以後，隋廷在江南已無力同時壓服這幾股力量，遂任其互相攻伐、彼此消耗，等到唐的軍隊南下，收拾的正是這盤散局。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict were the Sui dynasty and the Jiangnan rebel force led by Cao Shiqi and Lin Shihong. By 616 the Sui was an empire in name only: in the twelfth year of the Daye era Emperor Yang of Sui, Yang Guang, was stationed at Jiangdu, and the Ministry of War at Luoyang, far to the north, could move troops only through written orders and tallies, while at local level order was kept up by commandery vice-prefects, county magistrates and the commandery and county militia. The fubing establishment of the Kaihuang era had been drained away by years of conscription, and the real striking force of the Daye court consisted of hired soldiers and commandery troops mixed together, with personnel rolls that seldom matched the men actually present. The situation in the south was looser still: the commandery and county troops had not drilled for years, the private retainers and armed households of the great families held power of their own, and the prefectures' control over the countryside was reduced to paper. Cao Shiqi's side had the appearance of a typical rising of village armed men, made up of peasant farmers, flight-draft evaders, fishermen and loose men from the towns of Rao prefecture, with a leader who styled himself Prince of Yuanxing and appointed a major general, Lin Shihong; orders ran in a single stream and equipment was supplied by the men themselves, with none of the personnel rolls or logistics of a court. There were other powers at the same time in the Jiangxi region: the Prince of Liang, Xiao Xian, held the middle Yangtze, Zhang Shan'an rose at Fangyu, Feng Ang's clan had governed several commanderies in Guangdong for generations, Qiu He held northern Vietnam, and bands such as Du Fuwei, Chen Ling and Zhang Jinhu moved about the Jianghuai. After 610 the Sui court no longer had the strength to suppress these groups at the same time, and let them fight and consume one another; when the Tang armies came south, what they had to gather up was exactly this scattered board.
people: 操師乞，一名操天成，饒州鄱陽縣人（今江西鄱陽縣，屬上饒市），隋末地方割據勢力的首領之一，生卒年與家世都不見於史傳。據《隋書》與《北史》所記，他於大業十二年（616）起兵於鄉里，十二月癸未自號元興王，建元始興，攻陷豫章郡城，以林士弘為大將軍。隋廷派劉子翊率軍討伐，戰於陣前，操師乞為流矢所中而死。評書《興唐傳》把角色左天成的原型放在他身上，可見其名在民間說部中的殘留。林士弘是他的同鄉與部將：操師乞死後，林士弘接管其眾，在鄱陽湖一戰大破隋軍，陣中斬殺劉子翊，響應者多達十多萬；約在新舊交替之際稱楚帝（一說稱南越王），用延康或太平為年號，攻取虔州，勢力北抵九江、南至番禺，地方豪紳多殺隋郡守、縣令以相迎。劉子翊是本役另一位關鍵人物，他是隋廷派出的討伐者，兵敗身死，直接導致操師乞部的潰散與林士弘的接掌。往後十餘年，江南的棋盤由這批人寫下：蕭銳遣蘇胡兒取豫章、張善安襲焚豫章外城、馮盎一度歸附又反覆、李孝恭滅梁、楊世略斬林藥師、若干則討安成——每一手都接在操師乞開出的那個缺口上。
peopleEn: Cao Shiqi, also recorded as Cao Tiancheng, was a man of Poyang county in Rao prefecture, in today's Poyang county of Jiangxi under Shangrao city, and one of the local leaders of the late Sui; neither his dates nor his family background appear in any surviving biography. The Book of Sui and the Bei Shi record that he raised troops in his home district in the twelfth year of the Daye era, that is 616, and on the guichou day of the twelfth month proclaimed himself Prince of Yuanxing, opened the era Shixing, and took the commandery seat of Yuzhang, with Lin Shihong appointed major general. The court sent Liu Ziyi with an army to punish him; fighting took place in the open field and Cao Shiqi was killed by a stray arrow. The popular storytelling work The Story of the Rise of Tang places the model of the character Zuo Tiancheng in him, which shows how much of his name survived in the storytelling tradition. Lin Shihong was his fellow townsman and subordinate: after Cao Shiqi fell, Lin Shihong took over the troops, won a great battle over the Sui army at Lake Poyang, killed Liu Ziyi on the field, and drew the allegiance of more than a hundred thousand men. Around the turn of the year he proclaimed himself emperor of Chu, or as some accounts have it king of Nanyue, used the era names Yankang or Taiping, took Qian prefecture, and his power reached as far north as Jiujiang and as far south as Panyu, with local gentry killing Sui prefects and magistrates to hand their cities over to him. Liu Ziyi is the other key figure of this conflict: he was the commander the Sui court sent against the rising, and his defeat in the field led directly to the dispersal of Cao Shiqi's force and to Lin Shihong's succession. For the dozen years that followed, the board of Jiangnan was written by these men: Xiao Xian sending Su Hu'er to take Yuzhang, Zhang Shan'an striking and burning the outer wall of Yuzhang, Feng Ang submitting once and then changing his mind, Li Xiaogong destroying the state of Liang, Yang Shilüe killing Lin Yaoshi, and Ruogan Ze pursuing Lin into An Cheng. Every one of those moves was played on the gap that Cao Shiqi had opened.
kits: 卡面這件是早王朝時期的埃及長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上，用來守城垣，後來也用來收復失地。它與大業十二年的江南本無同代關係，但同一件兵器的骨架在這場起義裡確實找得到對應：長矛是冷兵器步兵的基本骨架武器，密集排開時能以矛頭壓住來者，收縮時能護住身體，短兵相接時能撐開對手的距離。起義軍的長矛來源雜亂，削尖的竹杆與木杆、削成扁平矛頭的農用工具、漁戶手中的漁叉與耙叉，數量雖大而規格不一；皮甲與布甲極為稀少，多數人靠衣物與皮革拼成的護具。金屬矛頭在江西造價不低，銅料須由嶺北或江南的冶坊運來，鄉民手中多數沒有銅頭。守城靠的是拒馬、木柵、落石與弓弩，豫章郡城的城垣與城門成了起義軍最有效的盾牌；鄱陽湖與贖江的水路，則讓漁船與農船改作載兵與運糧之用。隋軍一側的裝備整齊得多：步兵持槊、矟與環首刀，弓弩與箭囊配合使用，騎兵披甲執槊，攻城備雲梯、撞車、巢車與飛樓，並備火箭與投石；後方糧秣靠江船與人力沿贖江、饒河分轉各縣。說到底，這件埃及長矛在這場戰役裡的位置，是「以矛為骨的步兵隊形如何成形」的樣本：起義軍靠它守住了新得的城，隋軍靠更精良的槊與攻城器械試圖把那座城收回來。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is an Egyptian spear of the early dynastic period, a copper or bronze head bound onto a wooden shaft, used to defend city walls and later used to recover lost ground. It has no contemporary connection with the Jiangxi of the twelfth year of the Daye era, yet the skeleton of the same weapon can indeed be matched in this rising: the spear is the basic framework weapon of cold-steel infantry, and when ranked closely its points press back the attacker, when closed up it covers the body, and in close fighting it holds the opponent at distance. The rebels' spears came from mixed sources, sharpened bamboo and wooden shafts, farm tools pared down into flat heads, and the fishing spears and pitchforks of the fisher households, large in number but uneven in standard; hide and cloth armour were extremely scarce, and most men relied on padding and leather pieced together into rough protection. A metal spearhead was not cheap in Jiangxi, since the copper had to be brought from the foundries of the Lingnan side or the workshops of the south, and most of the village men had no copper head at all. Defence of a walled town depended on sharpened stakes, wooden palisades, stones dropped from above and crossbow fire, and the walls and gates of the commandery seat of Yuzhang were the most effective shield the rebels had; the waterways of Lake Poyang and the Gan River let fishing boats and farm boats be turned into troop carriers and grain carriers. The Sui side was far better equipped: foot soldiers carried glaives, long spears and ring-pommel sabres, with bows and crossbows and their quivers working together, cavalry wore armour and bore glaives, and for assaults they brought scaling ladders, battering rams, siege towers and flying towers, together with fire arrows and stone-throwers; behind them the grain and provisions were shifted to the various counties by river boats and by porters along the Gan and the Rao. In the end, the place this Egyptian spear holds in the record of this battle is that of a model of how a spear-framed infantry formation takes shape: the rebels held the new city with it, and the Sui tried to take that city back with better-made glaives and siege engines.
tactics: 起義軍的戰法是鄉民起事能用的辦法：以鄱陽鄉里為根，靠親族、姻婭與村社的關係把人召來，聚集與分散都在熟悉的河道與村道上完成。攻豫章郡城走的也是這套，一是趁郡兵防備空虛、城中守吏各自為戰時強攻城門與城牆缺口，二是靠城內響應者與地方豪紳在內部接應。得城之後，起義軍並未留下精兵固守，而是分兵四出掠取郡縣、把糧秣運回鄱陽湖與贖江的水網之中，這使它更像一條流動的補給線，而不是一座真正的根據地。隋將劉子翊的討伐軍一到，義軍立即在鄱陽湖一帶反擊：這場戰鬥有很強的水陸性質，義軍利用漁船與沿岸村舍避開正面攻擊，專找隋軍分隊與渡口切斷，把劉子翊的隊伍引到岸上狹窄處再合圍擊破，陣中斬其主將。得此一勝，十餘萬人響應，起義由郡縣暴動變成割據。之後的戰局呈現多方混戰：蕭銳的梁、張善安、馮盎與丘和各霸一方，義軍乘別人空隙擴張，也因樹敵過多而不斷退讓，先失豫章、遷都南康，再退餘干。到622年，義軍轉入山地洞穴，以險固守，棄城而不用，這是失去水網補給後最合理的選擇。隋廷這邊的戰術主軸是圍堵：郡縣重奪之後立即恢復徵兵、編制戶籍、封鎖水路，斷糧、斷船、斷援兵為主，攻城器械在江南水鄉難以施展，迫使起義軍離開水網深處；但同一套辦法在多股義軍並存時常常互相抵消。整場衝突的具體交戰次序、陣形編組與雙方損失數字，正史都沒有留下記載，只能由地勢、水文與兵器的限制去推想。
tacticsEn: The way the rebels fought was the way a rising of village armed men could fight: rooted in the village society of Poyang, they drew men together through kinship, marriage and village organisation, and both their concentration and their dispersal took place along the river channels and country tracks they knew. The assault on the commandery seat of Yuzhang followed the same logic: first they forced the gates and the breaches in the wall while the commandery troops were unprepared and the city officials each fought their own battle, and second they relied on men inside the city and on local gentry to act as a fifth column. Having taken the city, the rebels did not leave picked troops to hold it; instead they split up to strip the neighbouring commanderies and counties and to carry grain back into the water network of Lake Poyang and the Gan, which made their force a moving line of supply rather than a real base of operations. When the army of the Sui commander Liu Ziyi arrived, the rebels struck back at once around Lake Poyang. That battle was strongly amphibious: they used fishing boats and the villages along the shore to avoid frontal assault, cut off the Sui column and its crossings, drew Liu's troops onto narrow ground on the bank and destroyed them there, killing the commander in the fighting. With that victory, more than a hundred thousand men answered the call and a rising of counties turned into a power of its own. The war that followed was a many-sided scramble: the Liang of Xiao Xian, Zhang Shan'an, Feng Ang and Qiu He each held their own ground, and the rebels expanded into the gaps others left while being forced back, again and again, by the enemies they had made; they lost Yuzhang first and moved the capital to Nankang, then fell back to Yugan. By 622 the rebels had turned to the mountain caves, holding the strong ground and abandoning the walled towns, which was the most sensible course once the water network no longer carried their supplies. On the Sui side the main tactical line was to encircle: as soon as a commandery or county was retaken, the levy was renewed, the household registers were revised and the waterways were sealed, and the priority was to cut grain, cut boats and cut reinforcements; the siege engines of the Sui were hard to bring to bear in the water towns of the south, which forced the rebels away from the depths of the waterways. Yet the same method cancelled itself out when several rebel bands existed at once. The actual order of engagement on both sides, the grouping of formations and the casualty figures are not preserved in the official histories, and can only be inferred from the ground, the waterways and the limits of the weapons.
data: 可查證的數字大致如下。時間：大業十二年（616）十二月癸未，操師乞自號元興王、建元始興並攻陷豫章郡城；同年冬，隋將劉子翊率軍討伐，操師乞中箭而歿，林士弘在鄱陽湖大破隋軍並斬劉子翊；約在617年之交，林士弘稱楚帝、用延康或太平年號，取虔州；618年因張善安襲擊豫章、蕭銳遣蘇胡兒取豫章而兩度遷都（南康、餘干）；621年蕭銳的梁為唐將李孝恭所滅，部分部眾歸林，勢力一度復振；622年林藥師戰死於循州、王戎以南昌州降唐，林退安成洞穴，數月後病亡，眾散。兵力：義軍最盛時史稱多達十多萬人，須注意這是響應與附從之眾的總數，並非可作戰的精兵數；隋廷討伐軍的兵額沒有記載。距離：鄱陽縣城至豫章郡城（南昌）直線約一百五十公里，沿途約二百公里；鄱陽湖枯水期水面約三千平方公里，豐水期逾四千平方公里，義軍的舟船與糧秣都靠這片水網轉運。行政：饒州治鄱陽縣，豫章郡治南昌，郡境約當今江西大部，另及虔州、循州、南昌州一帶。隋朝整體的負擔可作對照：先後三次征高句麗，每次發兵以數十萬計，府兵編制在十餘年內被抽空，616年時全國能戰之兵相對有限。平叛所用時間、雙方損失與糧秣消耗的數字，史無明文，後世研究也只能以同年平定、數月之間一類概括語帶過。
dataEn: The figures that can actually be vouched for are roughly as follows. Dates: on the guichou day of the twelfth month of the twelfth year of the Daye era, that is 616, Cao Shiqi proclaimed himself Prince of Yuanxing, opened the era Shixing and took the commandery seat of Yuzhang; in the winter of the same year the Sui commander Liu Ziyi marched against him, Cao Shiqi was killed by an arrow, and Lin Shihong defeated the Sui army at Lake Poyang and killed Liu Ziyi; around the turn of 617 Lin Shihong proclaimed himself emperor of Chu, used the era names Yankang or Taiping, and took Qian prefecture; in 618, after Zhang Shan'an struck at Yuzhang and Xiao Xian sent Su Hu'er to take it, the capital was moved twice, first to Nankang and then to Yugan; in 621 the Liang of Xiao Xian was destroyed by the Tang general Li Xiaogong and part of its followers came over to Lin, briefly restoring his strength; in 622 Lin Yaoshi was killed at Xun prefecture and Wang Rong surrendered Nanchang prefecture to the Tang, Lin withdrew to the caves of An Cheng and died of illness within a few months, and his followers scattered. Numbers: the rebel force is recorded at its height as more than a hundred thousand men, and it should be noted that this is the total of those who answered and attached themselves, not a count of troops fit for the field; the strength of the Sui punitive column is nowhere recorded. Distances: from the county seat of Poyang to the commandery seat of Yuzhang, that is Nanchang, is about a hundred and fifty kilometres in a straight line and about two hundred along the roads; the surface of Lake Poyang is about three thousand square kilometres in the dry season and over four thousand in the wet, and the rebels' boats and grain moved on this water network. Administration: Rao prefecture had its seat at Poyang county, Yuzhang commandery at Nanchang, and the commandery covered most of what is now Jiangxi, together with areas around Qian, Xun and Nanchang prefectures. The overall burden of the Sui can be set against this: three campaigns against Goguryeo, each raising armies numbered in the tens of thousands, drained the fubing establishment within a dozen years, and by 616 the country had relatively little manpower that could still fight. The time taken to suppress the rising, the losses on both sides and the consumption of provisions are not in the histories, and later work can only carry the matter with summary phrases such as put down within the year or within a few months.
cause: 起兵的直接契機是大業十二年饒州鄉里的聚眾，根子則在隋朝把江南的元氣抽乾。開皇一代留下的府兵與糧倉體系，本可支撐一次像樣的邊防行動；大業朝卻把它連年透支：西征吐谷渾、南巡江都、三征高句麗，每一次都把大批丁壯與糧秣從江南抽上北方戰線，役負與轉輸的重量遠超州縣的承受。饒州一帶又是典型的產糧之區，水網密、漕運重，徭役與和買都落在農戶身上，遇上連年水旱與糧價騰貴，逃戶與流民大量增加，鄉里之間的互助網與秩序網一同崩解。地方武裝的傳統同樣存在：南朝以降，江南宗族與鄉里多有部曲、私兵與獵戶之屬，隋廷收編了其中一部分，剩下的則在郡縣控制鬆動時迅速武裝化。民間的氣氛也在推波助瀾，隋末讖語與歌謠四起，人心浮動，起事者一打起旗號，響應者往往旬日之內集齊上萬人。第三方的作用更不可忽略：江淮一線同時有陳稜、張金虎、杜伏威等部眾與蕭銳的梁，隋廷的注意力被分割，能派到江西的只剩下小股兵力。於是，一場以鄉民長矛與漁船武裝起來的起義，在饒州鄱陽這樣的產糧區最先成形：它不需要大量金屬裝備，只需要熟識水網與鄉里的人手，加上一位能讓眾人跟隨的首領。
causeEn: The immediate occasion of the rising was the gathering of men in the villages of Rao prefecture in the twelfth year of the Daye era; the root of it lay in a Sui state that had drained the strength out of the south. The fubing system and the granaries of the Kaihuang era had been enough to support one respectable frontier operation; the Daye reign drew on them year after year: the expedition against Tuyuhun, the tours to Jiangdu, the three campaigns against Goguryeo, each of them hauling great numbers of labouring men and grain from the south up to the northern fronts, so that the weight of corvée and of transport far exceeded what the prefectures and counties could bear. The district of Rao was a typical grain-producing area, dense with waterways and heavy with canal traffic, and both corvée and official purchase fell on the farm households; with year after year of flood and drought and with grain prices rising, the numbers of flight-draft evaders and displaced people grew large and the networks of mutual aid and of local order broke down together. The armed tradition of the localities mattered too: from the southern dynasties onward, the great families and the villages of the south had retainers, private soldiers and hunters, and although the Sui court took over part of them, the rest armed themselves as soon as the control of the commanderies and counties slackened. The mood of the people added its push: prophecies and songs circulated widely in the late Sui, hearts were unsettled, and once a rebel raised a banner the response often numbered tens of thousands within ten days. The part played by third parties matters even more: on the Jianghuai line there were at the same time the bands of Chen Ling, Zhang Jinhu and Du Fuwei and the Liang of Xiao Xian, so that the attention of the court was divided and only small detachments could be sent to Jiangxi. In the end, a rising armed with village spears and fishing boats took shape first in a grain district such as Poyang in Rao prefecture: it required no large stock of metal equipment, only men who knew the waterways and the villages, and a leader whom the others were willing to follow.
impact: 就眼前而言，這場起義把隋朝在江西的統治一次性掀開：豫章郡城易主，郡守與縣令被地方豪紳殺害以迎義軍，郡縣的徵兵、徵糧與司法同時停擺，隋在江南的政令自此只剩下紙面。林士弘建立的楚，名義上統有九江至番禺的廣土，但它建立在別人的真空之上，蕭銳、張善安、馮盎、丘和各據一方，義軍每一次擴張都是從別人手上搶來的地盤，也因此樹敵無數。對隋朝而言，江西的失控加速了帝國的崩解：616年之後不到兩年，煬帝在江都被宇文化及所弒，長安與洛陽相繼易主，隋朝覆亡，而這正是江南州縣早已不聽調度的一個註腳。對唐而言，這一帶是最難收拾的棋局之一：李孝恭先滅蕭銳之梁，順利接手兩湖與嶺南；再用招撫為主、武力為輔的辦法對付林士弘，一步步把楚的地盤收進州縣，622年冬林士弘終於走投無路，退入安成洞穴，而追擊他的唐將若干則仍無法將他擒獲。一場起義最終是以首領病死、眾散收場，而不是以戰敗收場，這在隋末唐初的割據者中並不少見；但正因為如此，戰爭留下的兵禍與地方記憶，往往比它的軍事成果更長久。民間說部把操師乞寫成左天成、林士弘寫成能打的梟雄，說明這一段歷史在正史之外另有流傳。
impactEn: As far as the immediate effect went, this rising pulled the lid off Sui rule in Jiangxi in a single stroke: the commandery seat of Yuzhang changed hands, prefects and magistrates were killed by local gentry to welcome the rebels, the levy of men, the levy of grain and the courts of the commanderies and counties all stopped working at once, and from then on Sui orders in the south existed only on paper. The Chu of Lin Shihong nominally held a broad territory from Jiujiang to Panyu, but it was built on the vacuum left by other men's absence: Xiao Xian, Zhang Shan'an, Feng Ang and Qiu He each held their own ground, and every expansion of the rebels was territory taken from someone else, which left them with countless enemies. For the Sui, the loss of control in Jiangxi hastened the dissolution of the empire: less than two years after 616 Emperor Yang was killed at Jiangdu by Yuwen Huaji, Chang'an and Luoyang changed hands in turn, and the Sui perished, a footnote to the fact that the commanderies of the south had long since stopped obeying orders. For the Tang, this region was one of the harder parts of the board to settle: Li Xiaogong first destroyed the Liang of Xiao Xian and took over the two lakes and the Lingnan without difficulty; then Lin Shihong was dealt with by a method that made pacification primary and force secondary, folding the territory of Chu into the commanderies step by step, and in the winter of 622 Lin Shihong was finally cornered and withdrew into the caves of An Cheng, though the Tang general Ruogan Ze who pursued him still could not take him prisoner. The rising ended with the death of its leader and the dispersal of his men rather than with a defeat in the field, which was not unusual among the regional powers of the late Sui and the early Tang; but precisely for that reason the wars and the local memories it left behind often lasted longer than its military results. That the storytelling tradition turned Cao Shiqi into Zuo Tiancheng and Lin Shihong into a formidable warlord shows that this stretch of history had a line of transmission outside the official histories.
result: 結果要分成兩段看。616年這一段：起兵成功，豫章郡城一度落入操師乞手中，隋將劉子翊討伐，操師乞中箭陣亡，林士弘接管部眾，在鄱陽湖擊破隋軍、陣斬劉子翊，響應者多至十多萬，江西一地的隋政令隨之瓦解。617至618年這一段：林士弘稱楚帝，攻取虔州，勢力北抵九江、南至番禺；但同年蕭銳遣將取走豫章，張善安又襲焚豫章外城，林士弘兩度遷都，先後退到南康與餘干，與此同時蕭銳、馮盎、丘和各霸一方，義軍在江南的版圖上反而被擠壓。621年蕭銳的梁被李孝恭所滅，部分梁軍散歸林士弘，義軍短暫復振。622年是最終轉折：馮盎正式降唐，林士弘遣弟林藥師攻唐循州，楊世略將其斬殺；王戎以南昌州降唐；同年冬林士弘一度請降又反悔，棄餘干退保安成山洞，據險自守，唐將若干則擊敗之而不能擒；不久他病亡，追隨者星散，楚政權至此瓦解，江西的州縣重新回到新建立的唐朝版圖之中。可以說，這場起義拉開了江南爭奪的序幕，卻沒有走到收拾結局的那一步。
resultEn: The outcome has to be read in two parts. The first part belongs to 616: the rising succeeded, the commandery seat of Yuzhang fell for a time into Cao Shiqi's hands, the Sui commander Liu Ziyi came against him, Cao Shiqi was killed by an arrow in the fighting, Lin Shihong took over the troops, defeated the Sui army at Lake Poyang and killed Liu Ziyi on the field, more than a hundred thousand men answered the call, and the Sui administration in Jiangxi fell apart. The second part covers 617 to 618: Lin Shihong proclaimed himself emperor of Chu, took Qian prefecture, and his power reached from Jiujiang in the north to Panyu in the south; but in the same year Xiao Xian sent troops to take Yuzhang away, Zhang Shan'an struck again and burned the outer wall of the city, and Lin Shihong moved his capital twice, falling back first to Nankang and then to Yugan, while at the same time Xiao Xian, Feng Ang and Qiu He each took a share and the rebels were squeezed on the map of the south. In 621 the Liang of Xiao Xian was destroyed by Li Xiaogong, part of the Liang army came over to Lin Shihong and the rebels recovered briefly. The year 622 brought the final turn: Feng Ang formally submitted to the Tang, Lin Shihong sent his brother Lin Yaoshi against the Tang prefectate of Xun and Yang Shilüe cut him down; Wang Rong surrendered Nanchang prefecture to the Tang; and in the winter of that year Lin Shihong offered to surrender, then changed his mind, abandoned Yugan and withdrew to the caves of An Cheng to hold the strong ground, where the Tang general Ruogan Ze defeated him but could not take him. Not long afterwards he died of illness and his followers scattered, and the state of Chu came to an end, the commanderies of Jiangxi returning to the map of the newly founded Tang. In short, this rising opened the contest for the south but did not carry the story through to its conclusion.
